run_camera_overlap_pipeline: run the main function to calculate camera overlap for all ScanNet train and val scenes
calculate_camera_overlap: calculate the field of view overlap percentage between two cameras using precomputed in-bounds point masks
extract_yaw_pitch: extract yaw and pitch angles in degrees from a 3x3 or 4x4 rotation matrix
save_overlap_info: save camera pair overlap, distance, yaw, and pitch data from a nested dictionary to a Parquet file
process_scene: process a single ScanNet scene to compute pairwise camera overlap, distance, yaw, and pitch for all image pairs
